name: chart/bullet
description: Bullet chart with background range bands, measure bar, and target tick.

meta.name: Bullet
meta.description: Bullet chart with background range bands, measure bar, and target tick.

props.name: width
props.description: Fixed SVG width in px. ⚠ **Omit for a responsive chart** — the chart fills and tracks its container via a ResizeObserver; there is no correct pixel number in a responsive grid. A fixed width is clamped to the container (max-inline-size: 100%) so it can never overflow its card, but it also stops the chart growing. `useChartSize` is NOT needed for this — charts call it internally.

props.name: height
props.description: SVG height in px. Unlike `width`, height does NOT track the container — this is the knob you set to change the chart's aspect.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS class names merged onto the root element.

examples.title: Basic bullet chart
examples.code:
import { Bullet } from '@cascivo/charts'

<Bullet value={72} target={80} ranges={[40, 70, 100]} label="Revenue %" />

whenToUse: Showing a single measure against a target with qualitative range bands
Compact dashboard KPIs where space for a full gauge is limited
whenNotToUse: Displaying a metric without a target or comparative range — use Kpi
Showing a simple completion or rated value — use Meter

related.name: Meter
related.reason: Use for a rated value within a range without a target marker

related.name: Kpi
related.reason: Use for a single headline metric with a delta

intent.a11yRationale: Renders with role="img" and requires a label prop for screen reader labeling.
